back.es: I can / I am able to (poder, yo form)
back.example: I'm sorry, I can't understand you.

note: The hint "am able to" usefully rules out "sé" in the "I know how to" sense of "I can"; in the example, "no te entiendo" is the more everyday phrasing, but "no te puedo entender" is natural and shows the target form.
